Title: I got H0033 “Unable to access Sentinel HASP Run-time Environment” error.
Content: The error message occurs when HASP driver is installed improperly in your PC. To check if the HASP driver is installed properly in your PC, type http://localhost:1947 or http://127.0.1:1947 in a browser and see if the following image shows up. If you cant see the image below, it means that the HASP drive is not installed properly. To solve this problem, download HASP driver from the link below and install it. Windows: http://211.191.168.213/data/haspdinst.exe Mac: http://211.191.0.168/213/data/Sentinel_LDK_RTE_Installer.dmg

Title: Can I use Marvelous Designer for physical garment production?
Content: Marvelous Designer is generally used in the video production or the game industries to create virtual garments and props, which means that Marvelous designer does not offer several functions that are essential in physical garment production. (e.g. to import/export DXF, to print out the paper patterns). If you are looking for a software to help you with proceeding the physical garment, we would like to introduce you to our sister software 'CLO 3D.' Visit www.clo3d.com or contact us at sales@clo3d.com

Title: There is another similar software called CLO, what is the difference?
Content: We have two different products called Marvelous Designer and CLO that have been specifically designed for the entertainment and fashion industries, respectively. While similar, CLO is equipped with additional features that are essential to fashion designers including avatar size adjustability and support for DXF-AAMA (drawing) files. On the other hand, Marvelous Designer including UV editor, sculpt mode Other features unique to CLO are: The ability to measure the avatar as a tailor would, tech pack (specifications) feature, diverse stitching visuals, and advanced CAD features. To learn more about CLO, please visit www.clo3d.com

Title: Animation Guide
Content: Animation Workflow Import an Avatar Import an Alembic or FBX avatar with animation(e.g., Mixamo, Daz, User own created) into Marvelous Designer. Create a garment for the avatar in Marvelous Designer Create fabric items that fit on the imported avatar. Simulation Retopology Create quad meshes with the Topology tool if needed. When using 'Remeshing,' some unwanted triangle meshes might be created. If you want all the surfaces to be quad meshes, please use the 'Patch Topology' or 'Create Topology' instead. Recording It is recommended to set the simulation quality as 'Animation(Stable)' for a more stable simulation while recording your animation. Save / Export Select the file format you would like to export from 'File -&gt Export' menu FBX or Alembic format is recommended if the file you create includes the animation. Animation Videos https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qP41F3EcoJk&ampt=2s https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tBvB-ppNjl8 Animation Manual Ver.12 - Animation Improvements: https://marvelousdesigner.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/12153605905049 Ver. 11 - Animation Improvements: https://marvelousdesigner.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4407120017049 To find more, please search 'Animation' in our Help Center web.

Title: Why do I have to pay tax?
Content: Please note that if you have a correct registered VAT ID, you can add VAT ID on Billing Address and your tax will be waived Since January 2019, CLO Virtual Fashion LLC(Marvelous Designer US office) has officially been registered VAT MOSS(Sales Tax) in Ireland(EU). - Since our online license sales are handled by our US office, all of our Individual license pricing will be in effect, according to the regulation below. From January 2015, new legislation came into force that affects the sale of digital services to customers in other EU countries. Digital services include broadcasting, telecommunications, and electronic services(which includes software products). The VAT rate that is calculated for this type of transaction is based on a place of supply the service. The legislation that is regulating MOSS rules is: Council Directive (EU) 2017/2455 - supplies of services and distance sales of goods (VAT e-commerce package). Council Directive 2008/8/EC - a place of supply of services. Council Implementing Regulation (EU) No 1042/2013 - place of supply of services. This means if your billing address is under the EU region, VAT rates for each country will be added to your purchase. Austria 20% Belgium 21% Bulgaria 20% Czech Republic 21% Denmark 25% Germany 19% Estonia 20% Ireland 23% Greece 24% Spain 21% France 20% Croatia 25% Italy 22% Cyprus 19% Latvia 21% Lithuania 21% Luxembourg 17% Hungary 27% Malta 18% Netherlands 21% Poland 23% Portugal 23% Romania 19% Slovenia 22% Slovakia 20% Finland 24% Sweden 25% UK 20% If you would like to discover more regarding VAT MOSS, please review the file attached.

Title: Usage - Trims and Details
Content: You can use various default items within Marvelous Designer. Also, you can import different types of OBJ or FBX files you made into the software to use them. Manual - Trims and Details Topstitch: https://marvelousdesigner.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/sections/360007305832 Button: https://marvelousdesigner.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/sections/360007401211 To find more, please follow the link below and refer to the 'Express Details' https://marvelousdesigner.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/sections/360007305872 How to put the OBJ trims on an avatar using the Morph Target You can put various OBJ trims which is very tight on your avatar using the Morph Target Follow the path below to load a file File -&gt Import/Import (Add) -&gt OBJ -&gt OBJ Dialog Window Load Type: Add Object Type: Avatar Automatically Add Arrangement Points: Unchecked Auto Create Fitting Suit: Unchecked You can increase or decrease the size of a trim imported to the software by clicking the scale icon from the gizmo. It is recommended that you do not change the placement of the trim. It could interrupt the stable simulation if the position of the trim changes after being imported. Simulate the garment to fit into the trim Once the simulation completed, import the original trim file as Morph Target File -&gt Import/Import (Add) -&gt OBJ -&gt OBJ Dialog Window Load Type: Add Object Type: Morph TargetM Morphing Frame Count: 30 (Input the desired number of frames.)

Title: My character skinned in 3dsmax looks a bit different after exporting as an open-collada format.
Content: Skinning an avatar in 3dsmax includes two categories called "Skin" and "Physics". An Open-Collada file format can only support the "Skin" way perfectly. If you face an issue importing an Open Collada file or importing an avatar including animation, please try with FBX either Alembic file format with PC2.
